o6_rubber_contact.apply_to: existing palm and finger collision meshes; no added rubber plates or cuboids
o6_rubber_contact.exclude: arm and wrist metal; visual material unchanged
o6_rubber_contact.note: Simulation friction values applied directly to original collision shapes. Coefficients have not been measured on the real rubber and ball.

mujoco_optional_initial_contact.note: MuJoCo friction means sliding, torsional, rolling; second and third entries have length units. This is an independent starting point, not a direct conversion of PhysX static/dynamic coefficients. Pair contact settings need explicit validation.

validation_required: Rubber material binding resolves on collision shapes after import.
Both hand-ball contact pairs use intended friction and restitution combine modes.
Ball remains held without weld or forced ball pose updates.
Opening fingers actually releases the ball at the expected velocity.
Check excessive sticking, release delay, penetration and solver stability.
